The Treasury · Brand Assets

Treasury Brand Kit

The Treasury is where the brand assets live, and this kit is their home: the wavy mark, the brand colors, and every platform colorway are chosen and kept here — nowhere else. The four supplied JPGs are the only sources; every variation is rendered live in the browser with CSS, so the originals are never altered. The Variation Lab below is the Treasury's tool for trying a new colorway before it is committed.

4 supplied originals, verbatim 5 brand colors Signature Heliotrope gradient 6 platform colorways Color via CSS filter / blend only Source files never converted or recolored

Brand colors

The five colors the whole system is built on — the three foundation colors plus the two Magentas that meet in the Signature Heliotrope gradient. Every field color in the colorways below is one of these, or a platform field recorded on its card.

#032B44

MSI Deep Blue

Role
The primary field. Backgrounds for Middleton Solutions, EMpro / Veritas Nexus, and the Treasury itself.

03

Signature Heliotrope — the brand gradient

Signature Heliotrope is the brand's representative gradient — the signature the brand carries across platforms. It is built from the two Magentas — LuxeVault Heliotrope #D751EE and MAP™️ Magenta #D552EF — founded on the brand's work with Open Source technology, and grounded in the brand's supporting colors: MSI Deep Blue, Rich Green, and Gold. Where a single gradient needs to stand for the whole brand, this is it.

Signature Heliotrope The brand's representative gradient · Founded on Open Source technology

Use it as the brand signature

Use Signature Heliotrope full-width wherever the brand itself — not one platform — is speaking: Treasury headers, cross-platform banners, and shared brand moments. Keep the stop order and positions exactly as recorded here; the two Magentas always close the gradient together, LuxeVault Heliotrope into MAP™️ Magenta. Do not substitute a single-magenta fade for it.

.signature-heliotrope {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #032B44 0%, #3E8E41 26%, #FFD700 48%, #D751EE 74%, #D552EF 100%);
}
04

Platform colorways

One colorway per platform, chosen and kept here in the Treasury. Each preview is the live treatment — the source JPG rendered with the CSS shown on the card, on the platform's real field color. The small chips under each preview are the same treatment at icon sizes, so legibility is judged before it ships. Every platform carries its colorway in the platform itself, in the header and as its icon.

Middleton Solutions
Icon 48 · 30 · 20 px

Gold & Slate on MSI Deep Blue

Platform
Middleton Solutions — site header & app icon
Source
mark-3-navy.jpg
Field
MSI Deep Blue #032B44
Why
The navy field of the source is crushed to black and screened away, so the gold & slate ink floats on the exact platform blue — not the file's own navy.
.msi-mark { background: #032B44; }
.msi-mark img {
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
  filter: contrast(1.75) saturate(1.3);
}
LuxeVault
Icon 48 · 30 · 20 px

Gold on Dark

Platform
LuxeVault — app header, vault icon & card art
Source
mark-1-mask.jpg (the monochrome mask)
Field
Warm near-black #0F0E0C
Why
The mask is inverted to a light mark, then a sepia–saturate chain tints it gold. The greys in the mask become the gold's shading, so the mark keeps its depth in a single luxury color.
.luxevault-mark { background: #0F0E0C; }
.luxevault-mark img {
  mix-blend-mode: screen;
  filter: invert(1) sepia(0.9) saturate(3)
    hue-rotate(2deg) brightness(1.05) contrast(1.02);
}
EMpro · Veritas Nexus
Icon 48 · 30 · 20 px

Light Mark on MSI Deep Blue

Platform
EMpro console & Veritas Nexus — console header & node icon
Source

Same field as Middleton Solutions, deliberately different mark: a clean silver-white monochrome reads as the operations layer, distinct from the gold & slate client-facing colorway.
.empro-mark { background: #032B44; }

Source
mark-1-mask.jpg (the monochrome mask)

Multiply drops the white field of the JPG into the paper, leaving the black & grey ink exactly as drawn — the sharpest, most literal rendering of the mark for a working tool.

07
Rules of use

        
What keeps the mark consistent everywhere it appears.

        

          
    
            
  1. 1This kit, in the Treasury, is the single home of the brand. Colorways are chosen here and kept here. A platform never invents its own treatment — it takes the one recorded on its card, or a new one proven in the Variation Lab and added to this kit.
    2. 
            
  2. 2Every platform carries its colorway in the platform — in the header and as the app / favicon-style icon, at the sizes previewed on its card. No platform ships with a bare white or navy box around the mark.
    3. 
            
  3. 3The four JPGs are the only sources. They are rendered verbatim; no converted, redrawn, or recolored copy of the mark is ever made. If a new colorway is needed, it is a new CSS treatment on a supplied file, tried in the lab first.
    4. 
            
  4. 4Transparency is a render effect, not a file edit. White fields drop out with multiply; dark fields are crushed to black and drop out with screen. The blend only works when the mark sits directly on its field color — keep the field as the element's own background.
    5. 
            
  5. 5Match the treatment to the source's field. White-field sources (mark-1, mark-2) take multiply on light fields and invert + screen on dark fields. Dark-field sources (mark-3, mark-4) take crush + screen on dark fields and invert + multiply on light fields.
    6. 
            
  6. 6Check it small before it ships. The wavy lines hold together down to 20 px; below that, use the mark inside its field-colored rounded chip (as in the icon rows) rather than floating it on a busy background.
    7. 
            
  7. 7Signature Heliotrope is the brand's signature gradient. Use the exact CSS recorded in section 03 — #032B44 → #3E8E41 → #FFD700 → #D751EE → #D552EF — whenever the brand as a whole is represented. The two Magentas stay together at the close: #D751EE (LuxeVault) into #D552EF (MAP™️). Do not reorder, drop, or replace a stop.
    8.
